pack.label: Phase 1 state-machine and severity seed
pack.description: Case-preserving state vocabularies kept separate by domain dimension, plus disabled severity labels with no thresholds, ranks, actions, or aggregate score semantics.

state_machines.label: Structured-output presence states
state_machines.description: Absence, null-like, ambiguity, restriction, invalidity, deletion, and unavailability remain distinct.

states.description: Eligible scope was processed and no supported value was found.
Evidence explicitly supports no value.
The field is not applicable under the exact schema context.
Evidence does not support one unambiguous value.
The relevant source region could not be interpreted.
Policy prevented processing or disclosure.
Untrusted output failed validation.
An authoritative deletion fence makes the value unavailable.
A required dependency or source was unavailable.

state_machines.label: Ingestion case lifecycle
state_machines.description: Explicit intake, safety, processing, cancellation, deletion-fence, and purge states from DIT-ING-001.

states.description: Durable acquisition or job identity exists.
Transfer is in progress.
Complete intake is durably recorded.
Structure and eligibility are being validated.
Malware and content-policy checks are pending.
Suspicious or unresolved safety result keeps content isolated.
Policy-pending content, including suspected clinical content, is held outside ordinary processing.
Eligible configured processing is underway.
Configured authorized review is required.
Validated immutable results and required projections are being published.
Configured processing-readiness checkpoints succeeded; no wider domain truth is implied.
A classified retryable failure retained the last safe checkpoint.
No automatic retry is permitted for this input and contract.
Durable cancellation intent is being reconciled.
Late processing results cannot activate.
An authoritative deletion fence blocks serviceability and processing.
Approved purge propagation is pending without a duration promise.
No serviceable content remains under the approved purge contract.

state_machines.label: Ingestion stage-run states
state_machines.description: Stage state remains separate from the ingestion-case lifecycle; worker output cannot set case success.

states.description: Stage has not started.
Stage attempt is running.
Stage contract succeeded for its exact input.
Stage has a classified retryable failure.
Stage does not permit automatic retry.
Stage was cancelled and late result activation is blocked.
A later generation supersedes this stage result.
Policy, dependency, quarantine, or deletion prevents execution.

state_machines.label: Extraction review states
state_machines.description: Extraction proposal/review state is separate from fact resolution and requirement fulfilment.

states.description: Untrusted value proposal awaits validation/review.
Configured authorized review is required.
Accepted as extraction only, not canonical fact.
A manual correction was appended with provenance.
Proposal was rejected without deleting evidence.
A later immutable generation supersedes this proposal.

state_machines.label: AI output execution statuses
state_machines.description: Execution status remains separate from capability-specific semantic outcome.

states.description: Schema-valid inert proposal; no domain acceptance or authority is implied.
Output requires authorized review.
Explicit limited or partial result.
Capability refused the request under its contract.
A declared retryable failure occurred.
No automatic retry is permitted.
Run was cancelled and late output cannot activate.
Deletion fence prevented processing or release.
Policy prevented processing or release.

state_machines.label: Applicability outcomes
state_machines.description: Applicability is evaluated before impact and remains separate from authority, health, severity, urgency, and action.

states.description: Required predicates are supported for declared scope and time.
Supported predicates establish non-applicability for declared scope and time.
Available evidence cannot determine applicability.
Authorized review is required.
Policy prevents complete applicability evaluation or disclosure.
Required rules, sources, or dependencies are unavailable.

state_machines.label: Impact primary classes
state_machines.description: Exactly one impact primary class is selected per affected item; separated dimensions remain separate.

states.description: A bounded technical transition may be representable; permission and execution remain separate.
Configured work or evidence from a person is required.
A rule supports notification need; recipient, channel, drafting, approval, and delivery remain separate.
Impact inputs or consequence require authorized review.
No configured action is recommended within declared evidence and coverage.

state_machines.label: Document comparison outcomes
state_machines.description: Supported change and supported no-change-within-scope remain distinct from partial, restricted, or failed comparisons.

states.description: Exact sources and two-sided anchors support the described change.
No material change was found only within explicit validated coverage.
The comparison cannot establish change or no change.
Authorized review is required.

state_machines.label: Retrieval and answer result states
state_machines.description: Support, conflict, freshness, completeness, restriction, and availability remain explicit.

states.description: Material claims have exact authorized support.
Authorized evidence conflicts and is not collapsed.
Relevant evidence fails the applicable freshness policy.
Declared retrieval or processing scope is incomplete.
Evidence is insufficient for the requested material claim.
Policy prevents complete retrieval or disclosure.
Required evidence or service is unavailable.

state_machines.label: Document-health signals
state_machines.description: Multiple evidence-health signals may coexist; they do not form an aggregate readiness or compliance score.

states.description: Supported applicability and complete authorized evaluation found no eligible option.
Evidence may be expired under exact configured rules and temporal evidence.
Evidence or source is stale under exact policy.
Evidence has a supported supersession relationship.
Eligible evidence conflicts.
Available evidence cannot satisfy evaluation requirements.
Policy prevents complete evaluation or disclosure.
Required governed source or rule is unavailable.

state_machines.label: Requirement-case user dispositions
state_machines.description: User attention and resolution inputs remain separate from applicability and fulfilment.

states.description: No user disposition has been recorded.
Evidence was added; fulfilment is not implied.
A configured alternative was selected; verification is still required.
An exception review was requested; approval or fulfilment is not implied.
A permitted user disposition was selected; governing applicability is not thereby proven.
Attention was dismissed without changing requirement truth.
A reminder task was set without changing requirement truth.

state_machines.label: Requirement fulfilment states
state_machines.description: Fulfilment is derived only from accepted verification and remains separate from receipt, extraction, tasks, notifications, actions, and elapsed time.

states.description: No eligible evaluation has completed.
Supported applicability and complete evaluation establish no fulfilled option.
Evidence is awaited or newly submitted.
Configured evidence verification is required.
The configured primary option has accepted verification.
A configured alternative has accepted verification without implying primary-document existence.
An exact approved exception has the configured fulfilment effect.
Eligible evidence or verification conflicts.
Policy prevents complete evaluation or disclosure.
A material change or configured expiry reopened prior fulfilment.

state_machines.label: Source-health states
state_machines.description: Conceptual retrieval, parser, freshness, coverage, governance, and suspension outcomes; thresholds remain unset.

states.description: Named health dimensions satisfy their exact policy; authority and applicability remain separate.
A named dimension is degraded.
Freshness policy is not satisfied.
Retrieval failed and a governed retry remains eligible.
Configured retry eligibility is exhausted.
Parser validation or execution failed.
Declared manifest coverage is partial or unknown.
Governance or security policy suspended the source route.
Source route is disabled.
Health cannot be established.

state_machines.label: Recommendation decisions
state_machines.description: Human/domain decision outcomes remain separate from recommendation generation and approval.

states.description: Request bound approval; approval is not yet issued.
Reject the exact recommendation revision.
Create a superseding edited recommendation revision.
Defer attention without changing impact truth.
Dismiss attention under policy without proving no impact.
Record a configured decision without replacing governing applicability evidence.

state_machines.label: Action execution lifecycle
state_machines.description: Approval-bound command, external outcome, reconciliation, repair, evidence, and reversal states.

states.description: Execution was requested for an exact approved effect.
Binding, policy, authorization, or fence check blocked execution.
Preflight is valid and dispatch has not completed.
Command was dispatched; real-world completion is not implied.
Adapter acknowledged the command without proving real-world completion.
External outcome is ambiguous and blind retry is prohibited.
Execution failed; retry requires exact policy and idempotency support.
Execution contract succeeded; requirement closure is not implied.
Only part of the exact effect succeeded.
External outcome is being reconciled.
Authorized repair is pending for a partial result.
Configured replacement/completion evidence is pending.
A separately supported and approved reversal is pending.
The supported approved reversal completed.

state_machines.label: Evidence verification outcomes
state_machines.description: Evidence verification is separate from extraction review, action success, fulfilment, and closure.

states.description: Evidence satisfies the exact configured criterion under current policy.
Evidence was rejected against the exact criterion.
Evidence is insufficient for verification.
Evidence conflicts and cannot be verified as one outcome.
Policy prevents complete verification or disclosure.
Evidence fails an exact supported validity rule.

state_machines.label: AI guardrail gate outcomes
state_machines.description: Policy/validator gate outcomes are set outside the model.

states.description: Proceed only to the next independent gate.
Return a narrower explicitly limited result.
Authorized review is required.
Refuse under the capability and policy contract.
Policy blocks the request or release.
Deletion fence blocks the request or release.
A declared retryable gate dependency failure occurred.
A terminal gate failure occurred.

state_machines.label: AI tool-call lifecycle
state_machines.description: Broker-owned tool lifecycle; the model cannot set state or broaden scope.

states.description: Untrusted typed tool request proposed by the model.
Tool request passed registered policy validation.
Exact call is currently authorized.
Broker dispatched the exact call.
Validated tool result succeeded for exact input.
Declared retryable failure occurred.
No automatic retry is permitted.
Call was cancelled and late result is ineligible.
Policy blocked the call.
Deletion fence blocked the call.
External outcome is unknown and is being reconciled before retry.
